title: Finite-group devissage from prime module cases
statement: For a projective family of schemes over a field with geometric fibres of dimension at most one, assume the higher direct images of every prime-order constant abelian group sheaf are constructible whenever the prime is invertible on the base. Then every higher direct image of a finite constant abelian group whose order is invertible on the base is constructible as an abelian sheaf.

proof.text: Filter a nonzero finite abelian group by a cyclic subgroup of prime order. Exactness of constant sheafification and the long exact derived-functor sequence express each higher image of the middle term as an extension of a cokernel by a kernel. The constructible kernel, cokernel and extension closure gives the induction step; the group order strictly decreases on the quotient, and the zero group is immediate.
